question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Absorb
solution:
The correct answer is “**Emit**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Absorb **means to take in or soak up a substance by chemical or physical action, typically gradually. (अवशोषित करना)

 
 
• **Example**- The sponge can absorb a lot of water due to its porous nature. 
 
 
 
• '**Emit**' means to send forth (light, heat, sound, particles, etc.) (निकालना). 
 
 
• ​**Example**- The old lantern began to emit a warm, flickering light, casting shadows on the walls of the ancient cave.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is Opposite in meaning to the given word is 'emit’.

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 4’**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• Ingest: This means to take (food, drink, or another substance) into the body by swallowing or absorbing it (निगलना). It’s more about the intake or consumption of substances rather than the action of absorbing or dissipating them.
 
• Blot: To absorb or remove (liquid) with a porous material (सोखना). It is similar to absorb in the context of taking in liquid but focuses more on the method of soaking up.
